entities.summary: Liliane Henriette Charlotte Bettencourt was a French heiress, socialite and businesswoman. She was a board member and one of the principal shareholders of L'Oréal. At the time of her death, she was the richest woman in France, and the 14th richest person in the world, with a net worth of US$44.3 billion.
